alt: A humanlike Realbotix humanoid robot with realistic silicone skin and facial features stands at the Realbotix booth at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, interacting with attendees
story: Salamanca City Central School District in rural upstate New York approved a $60,000 purchase of a humanlike AI robot named 'Sally' — built by Realbotix, whose sibling company manufactures hyper-realistic adult sex dolls — to teach high school students robotics; state education officials and the teachers union forced the school to pause the pilot after the manufacturer's product line was discovered.
why_funny: The school board vetted the robot's teaching credentials before anyone checked what else the manufacturer makes.
